tasks.short: Research animal nutrition, breeding and management improvements

steps.what: Define research questions, protocol and analysis specifications
outputs: protocol with variables, exclusions and analysis methods

steps.what: Conduct observations and assemble traceable animal research data
inputs: protocol with variables, exclusions and analysis methods

steps.what: Calculate specified research summaries and statistical estimates
inputs: protocol with variables, exclusions and analysis methods

steps.what: Interpret results and decide which improvements the evidence supports
Write the study record and improvement rationale
inputs: protocol with variables, exclusions and analysis methods

tasks.design: Use existing {DATA_PLATFORM} study forms and versioned calculations for agreed analyses, then a native {DOCS} study template. Scientists retain study design, observations, result interpretation and the scientific claims in the written record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated data preparation and calculation may sit beside research judgement in spreadsheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable study fields and tested calculations can be configured without autonomous research decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Biological variation and confounding can make a clean calculation scientifically misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a defensible design and distinguish an association from a useful intervention.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time repeating calculations while retaining experimental and interpretive responsibility.

reach.learn: Keep animal identity, units and observation provenance with each result.

evidence.claim: SciSure provides sample tracking and laboratory workflows; this supports structured capture capability, not this task's estimated research saving.
Versioned calculations and study templates could reduce repeated preparation; the proposed benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: This end-to-end research boundary includes protocol writing, data work, analysis and study records; overlapping specialised studies are counted once per actual project.

The scientist produces variables, exclusion rules and analysis methods in s1. The scientist captures animal identifier, treatment, observation time, value, unit and provenance and checks laboratory results in s2; that retained 20 hours includes field observation and source correction. Missing metadata stop calculations for manual resolution.
Use existing study forms and established statistical tools first; the calculation step creates draft outputs, not animal interventions or external reports.
Ordinary author saves stay within retained writing time without a self-approval stage.
unknowns: Whether study identifiers and units are comparable across source systems.
research_questions: Replay a completed study and count preparation, calculation and correction time separately from experimental work.

already_counted.description: Review results and interpret biological validity

incremental.description: Maintain calculation tests and study field definitions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=72, gross 28 minus 3 upkeep gives central net 25. Conservative case: incomparable study sources retain 24/25 data hours, novel analyses retain 16/20 calculation hours, and unsuitable templates retain 14/15 record hours: 94 retained, 6 gross minus 3 =3. A repeatable protocol retains 22 data, 7 calculation and 12 record hours plus 40 other hours: 81 retained, 19 gross minus 3 =16.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study management and environmental effects on animal products

steps.what: Specify effects, product quality measures and comparison design
outputs: comparison plan with measures and analysis rules

steps.what: Collect and reconcile management, feed, environment and product measurements
inputs: comparison plan with measures and analysis rules

steps.what: Compute specified product quality and quantity comparisons
inputs: comparison plan with measures and analysis rules
outputs: comparison tables with uncertainty and diagnostics

steps.what: Assess confounding and interpret observed product differences
inputs: comparison tables with uncertainty and diagnostics

steps.what: Document effects, limitations and supporting product results
inputs: comparison tables with uncertainty and diagnostics

tasks.design: Configure {DATA_PLATFORM} fields linking exposure periods with product measurements and reuse tested comparison calculations. A {DOCS} template carries result references while the scientist writes the interpretation and limitations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Feed, conditions and product results may require repetitive alignment before each comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit identifiers and analysis rules permit repeatable summaries without delegating causal judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Timing, herd composition and management changes can confound apparent treatment effects.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise whether the comparison actually answers the biological question.
tasks.altitude: Make product comparisons reproducible without treating observational differences as causal findings.

reach.learn: Preserve batch, time and method with each measurement.

evidence.claim: SciSure offers sample tracking and workflows; it does not establish causal validity or measured time savings for animal product studies.

assumptions: The boundary includes comparison planning, collection, calculation, interpretation and written results. Research projects overlapping task 5413 are not additive.

The scientist writes measure definitions, periods and analysis rules in s1 and produces animal/group identifier, exposure period, feed/condition values, product batch, test method and units in s2. Retained collection time includes capturing and reconciling these fields; missing links require manual reconciliation before s3.
Try existing study forms and statistical calculations first. No new sensor feed, automatic causal assessment or farm control is assumed.
The author retains normal save time without approving her own document.
unknowns: Whether exposure and product timestamps are compatible.
Whether existing analysis tools already remove calculation effort.
research_questions: Replay milk or egg comparisons with mismatched sampling periods and measure correction effort.

incremental.description: Maintain measurement mappings and calculation checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=77.5, gross 22.5 minus 3 upkeep gives central net 19.5. Conservative case: period mismatches retain 29/30 collection hours, bespoke comparisons retain 12/15 calculation hours and weak template fit retains 14.5/15 writing hours, plus 40 fixed hours: 95.5 retained, 4.5 gross minus 3 =1.5. Compatible batch/time metadata retain 27 collection, 6 calculation and 12 writing hours plus 40 fixed: 85 retained, 15 gross minus 3 =12.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research and direct animal selection and breeding practices

steps.what: Research breeding evidence and assemble animal performance records
Choose selection and breeding practices against biological and welfare constraints
Write the selection and breeding practice plan
Communicate the selected breeding plan to animal management colleagues
Control practice implementation and investigate deviations
Record breeding outcomes and justified practice changes

tasks.design: Use native {DATA_PLATFORM} views for identified breeding records and {DOCS} plan headings for repeatable documentation. The scientist chooses practices, communicates the exact plan and supervises implementation; an existing {OPS_SYSTEM} form reduces repeated outcome entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence retrieval and plan/outcome records can be mixed into breeding decisions and supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and document templates can reduce clerical work while keeping selection judgement explicit.
tasks.still_hard: Production goals, genetic diversity and animal welfare cannot be resolved by a universal ranking rule.
tasks.human_edge: Balance long-term biological effects and practical animal management constraints.
tasks.altitude: Make breeding decisions traceable without automating animal selection authority.

reach.learn: Link observations to the actual plan and animal identifiers.

evidence.claim: Native record views and plan templates could reduce retrieval and writing effort; breeding choices remain an unmeasured manual judgement task.

assumptions: The boundary includes the evidence lookup, written plan, separate communication, supervision and later outcome record.

Animal management staff produce existing animal identifiers, pedigrees and dated performance observations during routine husbandry; s1 includes scientist retrieval and reconciliation. Missing records require manual investigation, not inferred pedigree. The scientist produces chosen practices in s2 and observed outcomes in s5; s6 capture time is retained.
Use installed record views and document templates before custom optimisation. No hidden ranking engine or automatic animal instruction is proposed.
The communication gate confirms the exact plan and recipients, not approval of the author's ordinary save.
unknowns: How much evidence retrieval and repeated plan text exists today.
Whether the management record supports plan-linked outcome fields.
research_questions: Compare existing plan and outcome entry with native templates during one breeding cycle.

already_counted.description: Choose practices and supervise their implementation

incremental.description: Maintain breeding record views and plan headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact breeding plan version, animal scope, instructions and colleague recipients; changes require a fresh check before communication.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=90, gross 10 minus 2 upkeep gives central net 8. Conservative case: fragmented pedigree evidence retains 19/20 lookup hours, bespoke breeding plans retain 19/20 writing hours, and incompatible outcome fields retain all 5 record hours; 98 retained, 2 gross minus 2 =0. With compatible plan/outcome metadata, retain 18 lookup, 17 plan and 4 outcome hours plus 55 other hours: 94 retained, 6 gross minus 2 =4.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine animal population genetics and trait heritability

steps.what: Specify genetic population, trait definitions and estimation model
outputs: analysis specification with cohort, traits and model

steps.what: Assemble and check pedigree, genotype and phenotype data
inputs: analysis specification with cohort, traits and model
outputs: checked analysis dataset with identifiers and provenance

steps.what: Calculate specified genetic composition and heritability estimates
inputs: checked analysis dataset with identifiers and provenance
analysis specification with cohort, traits and model

steps.what: Determine whether genetic and heritability estimates support scientific conclusions
inputs: analysis specification with cohort, traits and model

steps.what: Write genetic findings with model provenance and limitations

tasks.design: Run established, tested statistical calculations in {DATA_PLATFORM} from a scientist-defined cohort and model. Keep data reconciliation, model selection and scientific conclusions with the scientist, and use native {DOCS} headings for the analysis record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rebuilding calculations and reconciling identifiers can absorb time without improving the scientific model.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned analysis specifications and tested calculations support reproducible estimates.
tasks.still_hard: Population structure, relatedness, sampling and environmental effects can invalidate a heritability interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the model's biological assumptions and the population to which an estimate applies.
tasks.altitude: Separate reproducible estimation from scientific determination of what the estimates mean.

reach.learn: Keep cohort, code version and diagnostics attached to every estimate.

evidence.claim: nf-core provides versioned, containerised and tested bioinformatics pipelines; this establishes pipeline infrastructure capability, not suitability of a particular heritability model.
Scientist-defined genetic estimation can use deterministic statistical tools; this workload's savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: The task includes model specification, data work, estimation, interpretation and its written record; it does not assume a new autonomous breeding decision.

The scientist produces cohort, trait definitions, exclusions and estimation method in s1. Laboratory staff produce genotype files during existing assays and animal management staff maintain pedigrees and dated phenotypes. S2 includes scientist reconciliation of animal identifiers, units, missingness and source versions; unresolved links return to manual source checks before calculation.
Use established statistical packages and native data views first. S3 creates draft estimates and diagnostics, not a committed external genetic report.
The small ordinary author save remains in retained writing time without a self-gate.
unknowns: Whether current estimators are already scripted.
How much identifier and phenotype harmonisation requires bespoke work.
research_questions: Replay a known cohort with deliberate identifier and unit mismatches and compare outputs against established estimates.

already_counted.description: Review diagnostics and qualify scientific conclusions

incremental.description: Maintain reference datasets, dependency versions and estimator tests

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=73, gross 27 minus 3 upkeep gives central net 24. Conservative case: incompatible pedigree/phenotype definitions retain 24/25 preparation hours, model-specific debugging retains 17/20 calculation hours, and incomplete output metadata retain 9/10 writing hours, plus 45 fixed hours: 95 retained, 5 gross minus 3 =2. A validated recurring cohort retains 22 preparation, 7 calculation and 8 writing hours plus 45 fixed: 82 retained, 18 gross minus 3 =15.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reproducible animal research with explicit ownership of biological judgement.
reach: Agree provenance and identifiers with technicians and bioinformatics staff.
role.ambitious_version: Reusable analysis foundations that leave scientists accountable for design, animal implications and scientific claims.
